en: A black-and-white postcard depicting a picturesque alpine village or small town nestled in a valley with dramatic, rocky mountains towering in the background. The image shows a grid of tidy houses, occasional grander buildings, and a straight road running through the village. The foreground includes trees and possibly a municipal building or hotel. The landscape is lush with fields and agricultural plots extending outward from the village.
